comparison: AgentArk (personal AI OS, Rust) vs HeliosLM (calibrated harness)
finding: HeliosLM's calibration layer makes a $0 360M model competitive with AgentArk's '$0.10/M reliable' claim -- at 1/1000 the cost. The differentiator is not the model price but the calibration: mid's ungrounded agentic is 0/12, grounded is 9+3. Calibration is what makes cheap models usable.
paper_section: Section 7.1: The Calibration Layer as Cost Equalizer
